##### Project general facts

Blossom 40 by Tranquil Infra Developers is a boutique residential building that blends minimalist luxury with clean architectural lines and a calm, green setting. The building rises above a basement level and a ground floor to nine residential floors and a rooftop, sitting harmoniously within the surrounding landscape like a quiet urban oasis. The collection offers one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, each with an additional room suitable for a home office, nursery or guest space, designed for families and professionals.

Amenities are concentrated on a curated rooftop retreat where wellness, leisure and play come together. Residents can enjoy a temperature-controlled infinity pool with a pool deck, a fully equipped gym and an outdoor fitness area for focused workouts, as well as a sauna and a steam room for relaxation. A rooftop social space with a barbecue terrace, a children's play area and a dedicated pet park add variety for families, while a welcoming lobby and lifts complete the shared spaces.

Interiors are filled with natural light, with spacious living areas, elegant kitchens and serene bedrooms finished in premium materials and a calm colour palette. Every detail is designed for practicality and visual harmony, from the flexible extra room to generous storage. Homes are offered either semi-furnished or fully furnished, giving buyers the choice between a ready setting and a space they can complete with their own furniture and personal touches.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a green residential community in Dubailand, set beside Al Barari, one of the greenest neighbourhoods in the city, where much of the master plan is devoted to gardens, lakes and trees. Landscaped parks, walking paths and community retail create a calm, family-friendly environment, while supermarkets, international schools and healthcare facilities cover daily needs close to home.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport. IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village, Dubai Outlet Mall and Dubai Miracle Garden are a short drive away, while Carrefour and Viva supermarkets and Mediclinic Parkview Hospital sit nearby. Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai Academic City and Arabian Ranches are within comfortable reach for work and leisure.

Majan is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the more accessible entry points to the Dubai property market. Green surroundings, direct highway access and proximity to major leisure attractions attract families and young professionals seeking value. Flexible layouts with an extra room appeal to tenants working from home, supporting steady rental demand and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
